affected.note: Personal information of 40,869 customers entered since the site opened through 2023-04-17. Of these, card information of 8,655 customers who paid by card from 2021-03-24 to 2023-04-17 may have leaked, and some cards may have been misused.

summary.en: Kurashiki Hampu reported that an attacker exploited a vulnerability in its online store and tampered with the payment application. Card data of 8,655 customers and personal data of 40,869 customers may have leaked.
summary.ja: 倉敷帆布は、オンラインストアのシステムの脆弱性を突かれ、決済アプリケーションが改ざんされたと公表した。顧客8,655名のクレジットカード情報と40,869名の個人情報が漏えいした可能性がある。
